source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
In your opponent's Shooting phase, this model can use this ability once per turn, when a ranged attack by an enemy unit targets a **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit of yours while this model is within 3" of that unit.

After the enemy unit finishes shooting, this model may shoot as though in your Shooting phase, but only at that enemy unit, which must be an eligible target.
